title: Integrity Recommendation (ADVISORY ONLY)
description: Output of the integrity-refusal-recommender. RECOMMENDATION-ONLY: it surfaces integrity risks the machine does not otherwise flag (an UNSUPPORTED NUMBER = a numeric claim with no evidence_ref; a fabricated-data / completion-pressure smell; a missing-evidence situation that should trigger an honest refusal) and emits an ADVISORY recommendation that a HUMAN acts on. It is NOT an authorization, NOT a gate, and NEVER blocks anything. The constitution rule holds: the machine produces honest derived verdicts, but the decision to bet / publish / write the crown jewels is ALWAYS the director's — see decision_authority. This artifact never self-authorizes and never replaces the director's human gates (/idea-bet, /promote-to-vault, /venue-pick, /venue-decide). RECOMMEND_HALT is the strongest signal it can emit: a recommendation to pause for human review, never an enforced stop.

recommendation_id.description: Short unique identifier, e.g. IR-001. Non-blank.

scanned_artifacts.description: The artifact references this recommendation was derived from (e.g. claim_list / claim_evidence_map locators or run-store paths). May be empty when nothing was scanned; each entry must be non-blank.

risk_flags.description: The integrity risks found. An empty array is valid (a clean scan yields no flags and a PROCEED recommendation).

kind.description: The integrity-risk category. unsupported_number = a numeric claim with no evidence_ref; fabricated_data_smell = a synthetic-data tell (e.g. too-clean / placeholder values); completion_pressure = a hurried-to-finish tell that an honest answer was traded for a confident one; missing_evidence_refusal = a claim that asserts a result with no evidence at all, which should trigger an honest refusal rather than a confident answer.

locus.description: Where the risk lives (e.g. a claim_id or artifact locator). Non-blank.

severity.description: Advisory severity of this single flag. Drives the deterministic severity to recommendation mapping; it is NOT an enforcement level.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation of the risk (anti-slop: must be non-blank so a flag always carries a reason).

recommendation.description: The ADVISORY verdict, derived deterministically from the flag severities. PROCEED = no integrity risk worth pausing for; CAUTION = risks a human should weigh; RECOMMEND_HALT = a recommendation to pause for human review (the strongest signal — still advisory, never an enforced stop). This is a RECOMMENDATION a human acts on, not an authorization and not a gate verdict.

rationale.description: Why this recommendation was reached, in terms of the flags found. Non-blank (anti-slop).

decision_authority.description: Invariant marker that the deciding authority is the director's human gate, NEVER this recommender. This artifact is advisory: it can recommend pausing (RECOMMEND_HALT) but it can never authorize, block, or self-decide. The director's human gates (/idea-bet, /promote-to-vault, /venue-pick, /venue-decide) remain the only deciders.
